name: Capacitor
description: Ideal capacitor with optional ESR and initial voltage.

tolerance.doc: Tolerance: each part's capacitance lies within this band of the nominal, drawn from the project's seed (ADR-034). 10 % is IEC 60062's code K, the usual grade of X7R ceramic capacitors; 0 for an exact part.

ic.doc: Initial voltage at t=0 (pin 1 relative to pin 2)

functional.claims: Pins only: an open circuit, as a capacitor is at DC (so a board's decoupling and filter capacitors run under every policy).
omissions: charge and the delays it gives

timed.claims: As electrical; a capacitor has no logic-level meaning.

electrical.claims: Linear capacitance with ESR and initial condition, trapezoidal/BDF2 companion (SPEC-004 §7 capacitor); each instance's capacitance drawn uniformly inside ±tolerance of the nominal from the project's seed and its id (ADR-034; nominal with settings.imperfections "ideal").
omissions: the distribution inside the tolerance band (uniform: a manufacturer guarantees the band only)
